controls_limitation: Control definitions and outcome-independent seeds/offsets belong to S4 authority bundle. Existing KR3-disabled ablation maps to KR1 and cannot be falsely counted as a new completed control. No control economics performed.

finite_neighbor_proposal.rationale: nearest integer +/-1 on the three actual policy coordinates; no Cartesian grid, no outcome-based width

runtime_limit: build_bundle requires exact equality to PARENT_SPEC; frozen replay does not expose numeric overrides. A separately reviewed sensitivity producer must vary only declared policy coordinates with full dependent/reference propagation; no monkeypatch activation is approved here.

state_and_reservation_impacts.EMA_neighbor: Changes both original reclaim signals and D reference EMA release, M2 suppression criterion, extension eligibility and runner exit. Rebuild whole causal D reference on same prefix with this exact neighbor policy; never inherit original outcome-based admission list.
state_and_reservation_impacts.HOLD_neighbor: Propagate HOLD consistently through source parent evaluator, D reference release, entry/actual KR paths, extension decision HOLD-1 and final cap 2*HOLD. Otherwise reference/actual semantics mismatch. No independent finalcap or runner tuning.
state_and_reservation_impacts.actual_slot: One actual symbol slot; signals at/before last actual exit remain blocked; all native excluded/open events retained.
state_and_reservation_impacts.reset: Fresh flat actual/reference state at each preregistered evaluation start; identical source warmup/first-index239 and unchanged seed formula. Never reset between trades except native lifecycle; no early release of D reservation from child exit.
state_and_reservation_impacts.source_gaps: Reference clock rejects timestamp gaps. Caps are observed bar offsets in path code; do not silently convert to hard96h or pad absent prices.
